structuralFinding: Expected value must model both outcome probability and crowd duplication. For an exact first-category combination with public selection probability q among N-1 other tickets, conditional expected share factor is E[1/(1+K)] where K~Binomial(N-1,q), equal to (1-(1-q)^N)/(Nq). Special-prize probability conditional on our hit is (1-q)^(N-1).
